description: Find the .cell name a CKB address chose for itself (its primary name), checked both ways: the address chose the name and the name still points back to it. Takes a CKB address (ckb1... on mainnet, ckt1... on testnet). Returns null for an address without one.

address.description: A CKB address: ckb1... on mainnet, ckt1... on testnet

network.description: Which Nervos network to read. Defaults to mainnet.

name: name_for_address
title: The .cell name of an address
